# Nibleaf

> Nibleaf Cloud is a managed documentation platform for teams shipping polished docs. Write in Markdown/MDX, get a fast searchable site with versioned publishing, custom domains, first-party analytics, and bilingual English/Arabic authoring with first-class right-to-left (RTL) support. The core remains open source under AGPL-3.0.

## Key facts
- Managed cloud hosting at nibleaf.com for app, publishing, search, analytics, storage, and custom domains
- Open-source core remains available for teams that need to inspect, extend, or self-host the platform
- WYSIWYG + Markdown editor that round-trips MDX components (callouts, cards, steps, tabs, code groups, accordions, params, math, Mermaid)
- Versioned publishing: every publish is an immutable snapshot; rollback is atomic
- Hybrid full-text + fuzzy search powered by Orama, built into every published site (bilingual, incl. an Arabic tokenizer)
- Arabic-ready, RTL-first bilingual authoring and reading
- Free beta for Nibleaf Cloud; open-source core licensed AGPL-3.0

## Comparison
- Nibleaf vs Mintlify / GitBook / ReadMe: a polished managed authoring experience with an open-source core and no per-seat lock-in.
